notes: One entry per optional (or core) asset MRLatte can run without at install time.
`envVar` mirrors the per-asset override backend/deps.py passes to module_path()
for the same asset. The capability check in backend/routers/modules.py resolves
each entry through that SAME function (env override > module root), so the asset
under the module root reports installed=true.
`files` lists the members the fast installed-check requires (exists + size).
For a single-file module `files` is omitted and `installTo` IS the file.
`bytes` is the full download size of the module, which may exceed the sum of
the required `files` (optional members are downloaded but not gated on).
`sources` is an ORDERED fallback list — the phase-4 installer walks it until
one succeeds. A non-redistributable module omits `github-release`.
`sha256` is null until the phase-4 release pipeline fills it in; the API
reports verified=false for any module without a recorded hash verification.

modules.name: MNI152 template (1 mm) + 2 mm brain mask
modules.description: Standard-space anatomical template used as the default base volume, plus the 2 mm MNI152 brain mask that bounds every lesion-network-mapping output.

license.attribution: ICBM 152 Nonlinear Asymmetric 2009c — Fonov et al., McConnell Brain Imaging Centre, MNI. mni152_brain_mask.nii.gz is the 2 mm ICBM152 brain mask as redistributed by nilearn (nilearn.datasets.load_mni152_brain_mask), saved verbatim (int8, 99x117x95, 2 mm) so the LNM bound is bit-identical to the pre-Phase-1b downloader path.

modules.name: Whole-brain tractography (user-supplied)
modules.description: Any whole-brain streamline set registered to the MNI template. Required for lesion-based virtual tract dissection. Not shipped: HCP-derived tractograms are covered by the WU-Minn HCP Open Access Data Use Terms, and any conforming .trk works.

license.attribution: Derived from Human Connectome Project data (WU-Minn HCP consortium). Subject to the HCP Open Access Data Use Terms.

slot.dropInHint: Drop any whole-brain .trk registered to MNI into this folder.

modules.name: Tract dissection engine (dipy)
modules.description: The streamline engine behind virtual tract dissection and LQTpy Analysis's dissection stage. Dissection also needs the whole-brain tractogram. One-click install downloads dipy and what it needs from PyPI (about 15 MB), each file checked against its pinned hash.

license.attribution: DIPY — Garyfallidis et al., Frontiers in Neuroinformatics 2014.

modules.name: DA-LNM connectome bundle (user-supplied)
modules.description: Per-subject component covariances used for degree-adjusted lesion network mapping. Any bundle produced by the DA-LNM preparation stage works, including a GSP1000 rebuild.

license.attribution: Derived from HCP resting-state connectivity (DA-LNM v2.1, see DaLnm/DA-LNM_Methods.pdf). Subject to the HCP Open Access Data Use Terms.
license.provenanceReview: RESOLVED: treat as non-redistributable. Built from HCP PTN1200 (HCP1200_Parcellation_Timeseries_Netmats, ~1003 subjects). DA-LNM_Methods section 'Access terms' states the WU-Minn HCP Open Access Data Use Terms restrict redistribution to users who have themselves registered and accepted them, and that the derived bundle should be treated accordingly. Users must obtain or rebuild it themselves and sideload. The same document names the GSP1000 normative connectome as the substrate to use where those terms are impractical - that is the route to a redistributable LNM module.

slot.dropInHint: Drop a DA-LNM .npz bundle into this folder.

modules.name: Longitudinal comparison (SimpleITK)
modules.description: Python package behind the longitudinal compare: registers a follow-up scan to its baseline and makes the difference map. One-click install downloads the official SimpleITK wheel from PyPI (about 19 MB, 104 MB installed) and checks it against the pinned hash.

modules.name: Retinotopy validation toolchain (neuropythy)
modules.description: Python package backing the Benson/Wang round-trip validation endpoint. Serves exactly one endpoint (/api/validation/round-trip). One-click install downloads neuropythy and what it needs from PyPI (about 41 MB), each file checked against its pinned hash.

modules.name: Network-map figures (nilearn, matplotlib)
modules.description: Plotting stack for the lesion-network-mapping panel's own figures and the retinotopy validation check. Reports don't need it: MRLatte draws their figures itself. One-click install downloads nilearn, matplotlib, pandas and what they need from PyPI (about 51 MB), each file checked against its pinned hash.
